description: This file defines an enum `FuelAutoTune2` that implements fuel autotuning logic for an automotive ECU system. It contains a method `process` that analyzes AFR data points and adjusts VE (Volumetric Efficiency) values based on fuel mixture accuracy.

classes.name: FuelAutoTune2
classes.description: An enum singleton implementing fuel autotuning logic, providing a method to process AFR data and adjust VE values for engine tuning.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Analyzes AFR data points and adjusts volumetric efficiency (VE) values based on deviations from target AFR, returning a Result object with the new VE grid.
